'''Steven Lewis and Clint Hays Unknown Deck''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Steven Lewis]] and [[Clint Hays]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/darkside.html Hays and Lewis' Unknown Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000606145048/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/darkside.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Steven Lewis]] and [[Clint Hays]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Occupation
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Lewis Hays DS Unknown Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
An [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation]] deck by [[Steven Lewis]] and [[Clint Hays]] with seven [[Raithal Operative]]s and seven [[3,720 To 1]].<ref name="torch" />
